regions.merged_text: April 7, 1955. Holy Thursday. God bless you Miss Doras -- you and yours for blessed, Joyful Easter! Many thanks two for the appreciated "Lives of saints" received several months back and was only recently discovered -- in fact just yesterday. Fr. Guardian is quite pleased to have in the House -- as are we all.
